successfulPlatePrompts.name: bedroom
successfulPlatePrompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a finished ultra-detailed cinematic environment matte painting for an interactive portfolio in the visual language of Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse and the Sunflower music video. This is a professional animation-studio final background, not a sketch, not a toy low-poly render. Wide landscape composition 16:9. A lived-in Brooklyn teenager/software engineer bedroom at blue hour: scarred wooden work desk and glowing computer on left, sketchbooks and headphones, carefully authored stickers, taped original graphic art and pinned diagrams, red rumpled bedding with sculpted folds on right, massive industrial sash window with detailed New York rooftops, fire escapes and water towers outside. At right-center by the window stands a fully masked Miles Morales Spider-Man in his black/red suit with open red hoodie, anatomically expressive, natural contrapposto, looking out at the city. He is a small supporting figure, about 18 percent image height. Room has no other people. Medium-wide low camera, layered foreground desk corner and clutter at edges, coherent real depth, diagonal amber late sunlight from window against cool violet/cyan monitor light, sharp graphic shadows and volumetric dust. Rich dimensional comic illustration: varied ink contours, fine construction linework, tactile hand-painted chipped plaster and wood, selective halftone on shadow planes, hatching on fabric, restrained cyan/magenta print offsets on object edges. Strong cinematic value hierarchy. Leave a quiet readable dark-violet zone across left-middle for live web typography; no giant empty void, the room still fills the frame. Precise detailed foreground, atmospheric exterior. No text, no captions, no logos, no watermark, no UI. Keep saturated light accents selective, materials locally colored, no glossy plastic, no photorealism, no cottagecore. Make every prop feel individually designed.

successfulPlatePrompts.name: climb
successfulPlatePrompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Input image 1 is ONLY a visual style and masked-character reference, not an edit target. Create a NEW wide 16:9 finished animation-studio cinematic background plate in the SAME detailed dimensional comic style: Spider-Man Into the Spider-Verse / Sunflower music-video visual language. Maintain the same masked Miles Morales character: black suit, red spider accents, expressive proportions and red hoodie where appropriate. Fine varied ink contours, painted textures, tactile worn materials, sculpted fabric, deliberate halftone and crosshatching on selected shadows, restrained cyan/magenta edge print echoes. Coherent perspective, cinematic value design, selective saturation, authored lighting, atmospheric depth. No UI, no watermark, no website captions. Keep left-middle reasonably quiet/dark for readable live typography. This must look like a professional studio final frame, not a concept sketch, photoreal photo or low-poly toy render. Scene: a dramatic Brooklyn wall-climb shot, steep upward camera angle along enormous richly weathered red-brown brick façade. Tall dimensional sash windows, cornice ledges, metal drainpipes, narrow fire escape shadows, torn paper remnants, chips and patched mortar; vertiginous perspective leading to brilliant sunset and distant city glimpsed at top edge. Fully masked Miles in black suit with red accents, WITHOUT hoodie, climbs at right third in a convincing stretched climbing pose: one hand gripping a ledge, opposite arm reaching above, knees bent and feet planted against brick. Full body visible, about 35 percent image height, expressive ink silhouette, fabric/comic shading. One strong amber sun edge, cool purple graphic wall shadows, highly detailed window frame in near foreground partially intruding from lower-left. Small pale stencil 'KEEP GOING' physically painted on brick in a quieter central area, no other lettering. Make the wall feel vast and the ascent cinematic.

layerPrompts.name: climb-clean
layerPrompts.prompt: Edit target: input image 1. Remove ONLY the masked climbing Spider-Man character and his immediate cast shadow from the right-middle brick wall. Reconstruct the underlying brick, mortar, pipes and sunset lighting seamlessly in the same finished painted comic style. Preserve the exact full canvas, camera perspective, foreground windows, architecture, all stencil lettering, skyline, lighting, colors, texture, composition and every other object. No new characters, no new objects, no camera reframing. This is a clean background plate for compositing; character must be completely absent.

layerPrompts.name: climb-hero
layerPrompts.prompt: Edit target: input image 1. Create a transparent-background extraction of ONLY the masked climbing Spider-Man character, including every fingertip, shoe, limb and suit contour. Preserve the EXACT existing pose, character appearance, painted ink style, red spider, lighting, proportions and original pixel location within the FULL landscape canvas. Preserve the full original wide canvas and character size/position; do not center, enlarge or recrop him. Delete all wall, pipe, window, typography, city and background pixels to genuine alpha transparency. Do not include cast shadow on the wall. Clean antialiased alpha edges without white or colored background halos.

note: Street, graffiti and night character requests and a transparent climber extraction were rejected by image service. Environment-only replacement prompts are included. The clean climb variant is retained as an optional compositing source.
